name: code/node-server
title: Node.js JSON API server
summary: HTTP JSON API in Node with no dependencies: routing, input checks, error replies and node:test tests.
when: Use when the user wants a small HTTP JSON API in Node.js that must run with no npm packages installed.

name.about: Service name, used as the package name, in the README title and in the start-up log line (lowercase).

next: Write every file under files/ into the user's project, run node --test to confirm the tests pass, then run node src/server.js and call the routes with curl.
